047import java.awt.datatransfer.DataFlavor;
048import java.awt.datatransfer.StringSelection;

050import java.awt.datatransfer.UnsupportedFlavorException;
051import java.awt.event.InputEvent;
052import java.awt.event.KeyAdapter;
053import java.awt.event.KeyEvent;
054import java.io.IOException;
055import java.lang.System.Logger;

069/**
070 * Key adapter for JTable and SsTable that manages cut and paste functionality
071 * between a table and either another table or a spreadsheet.
072 */
073public class SsTableKeyAdapter extends KeyAdapter {
074  /** Logger for component */
075  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
076
077  /**
078   * Takes the column number and string value to be set for that column and
079   * converts the string in to appropriate class. The class is found by calling
080   * the getColumnClass() method of the JTable.
081   *
082   * @param jTable JTable containing target object
083   * @param column the column number for which new value has to be set.
084   * @param value  string representation of the new value.
085   *
086   * @return returns the value as a column class object.
087   * @throws Exception catch all exception
088   */
089  protected static Object getObjectToSet(JTable jTable, int column, String value) throws Exception {
090    // GET THE COLUMN CLASS
091    final Class<?> objectClass = jTable.getColumnClass(column);
092    Object newValue = null;
093    try {
094      // CONSTRUCT THE OBJECT ONLY IF THE STRING IS NOT NULL
095      if (value != null) {
096        // DATE CLASS DOESN'T HAVE A CONSTRUCTOR THAT TAKES A STRING
097        if (objectClass.equals(java.sql.Date.class)) {
098          newValue = Date.valueOf(value);
099        } else {
100          // GET THE CONSTRUCTOR FOR THE CLASS WHICH TAKES A STRING
101          final Constructor<?> constructor
102              = objectClass.getConstructor(new Class<?>[] {String.class});
103
104          // CREATE AN INSTANCE OF THE OBJECT
105          newValue = constructor.newInstance(new Object[] {value});
106        }
107      }
108    } catch (final NoSuchMethodException nsme) {
109      logger.log(WARNING, "No Such Method Exception. Failed to copy data.", nsme);
110      newValue = value;
111    }
112
113    // RETURN THE NEWLY CREATED OBJECT.
114    return newValue;
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Indicates whether or not row insertions are allowed via cut/copy and paste.
119   */
120  protected boolean allowInsertion = false;
121
122  /**
123   * Indicates row used for insertion in SsTable.
124   */
125  protected boolean forSsDataGrid = false;
126
127  /**
128   * Off state for copying or pasting.
129   */
130  protected int offMask = InputEvent.ALT_DOWN_MASK | InputEvent.SHIFT_DOWN_MASK;
131
132  /**
133   * On state for copying or pasting.
134   */
135  protected int onMask = InputEvent.CTRL_DOWN_MASK;
136
137  /**
138   * Constructs a KeyAdapter for the JTable.
139   *
140   * @param jTable JTable for which copy and paste support should be added.
141   */
142  @SuppressWarnings("OverridableMethodCallInConstructor")
143  public SsTableKeyAdapter(JTable jTable) {
144    init(jTable);
145  }
146
147  /**
148   * Adds the key listener for the specified JTable.
149   * @param jTable table for which listener is to be added
150   */
151  protected void init(JTable jTable) {
152    jTable.addKeyListener(this);
153  }
154
155  /**
156   * Invoked when a key is released.
157   * @param ke
158   */
159  @Override
160  public void keyReleased(KeyEvent ke) {
161    final StringBuilder strBuf = new StringBuilder();
162
163    final JTable jTable = (JTable) ke.getSource();
164
165    logger.log(DEBUG,
166               () -> sf("Key Released on SsDataGrid. Key Released: %s %s.", ke.getKeyCode(),
167                        ((ke.getModifiersEx() & (onMask | offMask)) == onMask)));
168
169    if (((ke.getModifiersEx() & (onMask | offMask)) == onMask)
170        && (ke.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_C)) {
171      // CHECK IF CONTROL-C IS PRESSED
172      // SHIFT OR ALT SHOULD NOT BE DOWN
173
174      // ALERT USER
175      logger.log(DEBUG, "Going to handle copy");
176
177      // GET COLUMNS INVOLVED
178      final int numRows = jTable.getSelectedRowCount();
179      int numColumns = jTable.getSelectedColumnCount();
180
181      // CHECK IF THERE IS ATLEAST ONE SELECTED CELL.
182      // IF NOT NOTHING TO COPY JUST RETURN.
183      if ((numRows < 1) || (numColumns < 1)) {
184        return;
185      }
186
187      // GET THE ROWS AND COLUMNS SELECTED.
188      final int[] selectedRows = jTable.getSelectedRows();
189      int[] selectedColumns = jTable.getSelectedColumns();
190
191      // COPY THE DATA IN THE SELECTED ROWS AND COLUMNS
192      // APPEND A TAB AFTER EACH CELL AND A NEW LINE CHAR AT END OF EACH ROW.
193      for (int i = 0; i < selectedRows.length; i++) {
194        for (int j = 0; j < selectedColumns.length; j++) {
195          strBuf.append(jTable.getValueAt(selectedRows[i], selectedColumns[j]));
196          if (j < (numColumns - 1)) {
197            strBuf.append("\t");
198          }
199        }
200        strBuf.append("\n");
201      }
202
203      // GET THE SYSTEM CLIPBOARD
204      final Clipboard clipboard = Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().getSystemClipboard();
205
206      // CREATE A TRANSFERABLE OBJECT
207      final StringSelection stringSelection = new StringSelection(strBuf.toString());
208
209      // COPY THE DATA TO CLIP BOARD
210      clipboard.setContents(stringSelection, stringSelection);
211
212    } else if (((ke.getModifiersEx() & (onMask | offMask)) == onMask)
213               && (ke.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_V)) {
214      // CHECK IF CONTROL-V IS PRESSED
215      // SHIFT OR ALT SHOULD NOT BE DOWN
216
217      // GET CLIPBOARD
218      final Clipboard clipboard = Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().getSystemClipboard();
219
220      // GET THE CONTENTS OF THE CLIPBOARD
221      final Transferable transferable = clipboard.getContents(this);
222
223      // IF THE CONTENT TYPE SUPPORTS STRING TYPE GET THE DATA.
224      if (transferable.isDataFlavorSupported(DataFlavor.stringFlavor)) {
225        // GET DATA FROM CLIPBOARD
226        String strData;
227        try {
228          strData = (String) transferable.getTransferData(DataFlavor.stringFlavor);
229        } catch (final UnsupportedFlavorException ufe) {
230          logger.log(ERROR, "Unsupported Flavor Exception.", ufe);
231          return;
232        } catch (final IOException ioe) {
233          logger.log(ERROR, "IO Exception.", ioe);
234          return;
235        }
236
237        // IF USER HAS NOT SELECTED ANY CELL THEN DO NOT COPY.
238        if ((jTable.getSelectedRowCount() < 1) || (jTable.getSelectedColumnCount() < 1)) {
239          return;
240        }
241
242        // GET THE SELECTED ROWS AND COLUMNS
243        final int[] selectedRows = jTable.getSelectedRows();
244        final int[] selectedColumns = jTable.getSelectedColumns();
245
246        // CREATE A STRING TOKENIZER TO BREAK THE DATA INTO ROWS.
247        StringTokenizer rowTokens = new StringTokenizer(strData, "\n", false);
248
249        // INITIALIZE THE NUMBER OF ROWS AND COLUMNS
250        int numRows = 0;
251        int numColumns = 0;
252
253        StringTokenizer columnTokens;
254
255        // SEE IF THE DATA HAS ATLEAST ONE ROW
256        // IF IT DOES GET THE NUMBER OF COLUMNS PRESENT.
257        if (rowTokens.hasMoreTokens()) {
258          numRows++;
259          columnTokens = new StringTokenizer(rowTokens.nextToken(), "\t", false);
260          // WHILE THERE ARE TOKENS INCREMENT THE COLUMN COUNT
261          for (; columnTokens.hasMoreTokens(); numColumns++) {
262            columnTokens.nextToken();
263          }
264        }
265
266        // GET THE NUMBER OF ROWS PRESENT
267        for (; rowTokens.hasMoreTokens(); numRows++) {
268          rowTokens.nextToken();
269        }
270
271        // GET THE NUMBER OF COLUMNS AND ROWS IN THE JTABLE.
272        int rowCount = jTable.getRowCount();
273        final int columnCount = jTable.getColumnCount();
274
275        if (forSsDataGrid || (jTable instanceof SsTable)) {
276          rowCount--;
277        }
278
279        // IF THE NUMBER OF COLUMNS NEEDED TO COPY FROM CLIPBOARD
280        // IS MORE THAN THAT IN JTABLE CANCEL COPY
281        // YOU HAVE TO CHECK THIS FROM THE STARTING SELECTED CELL
282        // NO NEED TO ADD ONE FOR SELECTEDCOLUMNS[0] AS THE PASTING STARTS FROM THAT
283        // ITSELF
284        if (columnCount < (numColumns + selectedColumns[0])) {
285          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
286              jTable, "There are not enough columns in the table to copy into.\n");
287          return;
288        }
289
290        int numRowsToCopy = numRows;
291
292        // SEE IF SUFFICENT ROWS ARE PRESENT.
293        if (rowCount < (numRows + selectedRows[0])) {
294          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(jTable,
295                                        "There are not enough rows in the table to copy into.\n");
296          if (allowInsertion) {
297            final int option = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(
298                jTable, "Do you want to insert new rows?", "Add Rows", JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION);
299            if (option == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) {
300              // SET THE NUMBER OF ROWS TO COPY EQUAL TO
301              // NUMBER OF ROWS IN DATA.
302              numRowsToCopy = numRows;
303            } else if (JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(
304                           jTable, "Do you want to copy data into just the rows present?",
305                           "Limited Copy", JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION)
306                       == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) {
307              // GET THE NUMBER OF ROWS FROM SELECTED ROW TO LAST ROW
308              // NO NEED TO ADD A ONE
309              numRowsToCopy = rowCount - selectedRows[0];
310            }
311          } else if (JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(
312                         jTable, "Do you want to copy data into just the rows present?",
313                         "Limited Copy", JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION)
314                     == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) {
315            // GET THE NUMBER OF ROWS FROM SELECTED ROW TO LAST ROW
316            // NO NEED TO ADD A ONE
317            numRowsToCopy = rowCount - selectedRows[0];
318          }
319        }
320
321        // COPY THE DATA FROM CLIP BOARD TO JTABLE
322        try {
323          // TOKENIZE DATA IN TO ROWS
324          rowTokens = new StringTokenizer(strData, "\n", false);
325
326          // WHILE THERE ARE ROWS IN THE CLIP BOARD DATA AND NUMBER OF ROWS
327          // COPIED IS LESS THEN WE SHOULD COPY DATA TO JTABLE.
328          for (int i = 0; rowTokens.hasMoreTokens() && (i < numRowsToCopy); i++) {
329            // TOKENIZE THE ROW INFORMATION IN TO COLUMNS
330            columnTokens = new StringTokenizer(rowTokens.nextToken(), "\t", false);
331            // PASTE THE DATA IN TO JTABLE ROW.
332            for (int j = 0; columnTokens.hasMoreTokens(); j++) {
333              // GET THE VALUE FOR THIS CELL IN THE FORM OF THIS COLUMN CLASS OBJECT
334              final Object newValue
335                  = getObjectToSet(jTable, selectedColumns[0] + j, columnTokens.nextToken());
336              // SET THE VALUE FOR THE COLUMN
337              jTable.setValueAt(newValue, selectedRows[0] + i, selectedColumns[0] + j);
338            }
339          }
340
341          // UPDATE THE UI AS WE HAVE UPDATED UNDERLIYING DATA
342          // THIS HAS TO PROPOGATE TO THE SCREEN.
343          jTable.updateUI();
344
345        } catch (final NoSuchMethodException nsme) {
346          logger.log(ERROR,
347                     "No Such Method Exception. One of the column classes does not provide a "
348                         + "constructor that takes a single String argument.",
349                     nsme);
350          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(jTable,
351                                        "One of the column classes does not provide a constructor "
352                                            + "that takes a single String argument.");
353        } catch (final SecurityException se) {
354          logger.log(ERROR,
355                     "Security Exception. One of the column class does not provide a constructor "
356                         + "that takes a single String argument.",
357                     se);
358          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(jTable,
359                                        "One of the column class does not provide a constructor "
360                                            + "that takes a single String argument.");
361        } catch (final InstantiationException ie) {
362          logger.log(ERROR,
363                     "(Instantiation Exception. Failed to copy data. Error occured while "
364                         + "instantiating a single String argument constructor for a column.",
365                     ie);
366          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(jTable,
367                                        "Failed to copy data. Error occured while instantiating a "
368                                            + "single String argument constructor for a column.");
369        } catch (final Exception e) {
370          logger.log(ERROR, "Exception. Failed to copy data.", e);
371          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(jTable, "Failed to copy data.");
372        }
373
374      } // end if (transferable.isDataFlavorSupported(DataFlavor.stringFlavor)) {
375
376    } // end if (((ke.getModifiersEx() & (onMask | offMask)) == onMask) &&
377    // ke.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_C) {
378
379  } // end public void keyReleased(KeyEvent ke) {
380
381  /**
382   * Sets allowInsertion indicator. Set true if new rows can be added to JTable
383   * via cut/copy and paste - otherwise false. False by default.
384   *
385   * @param allowInsertion true if new rows can be added when pasting data from
386   *                        clipboard, else false.
387   */
388  public void setAllowInsertion(boolean allowInsertion) {
389    this.allowInsertion = allowInsertion;
390  }
391
392  /**
393   * Sets forSsDataGrid indicator. True if the key adapter is used for SsDataGrid
394   * -- otherwise false. False by default.
395   *
396   * @param forSsDataGrid - true if this key adapter is used for SsTable, else
397                     false.
398   */
399  public void setForSsDataGrid(boolean forSsDataGrid) {
400    this.forSsDataGrid = forSsDataGrid;
401  }
402}
